title: The multiplicative group sheaf G_m on the small pro-etale site
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme, $S_{\mathrm{proet}}$ its small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site] and $\mathcal O_S$ its structure sheaf of rings
[def-pur-proetale-structure-sheaf]. The *multiplicative group*
$\mathbf G_{m,S}=\mathcal O_S^\times$ is the presheaf of abelian groups (written
multiplicatively)

$$
 \mathbf G_{m,S}(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times\qquad(U\to S\text{ weakly etale}),
$$

the group of units of the ring $\mathcal O_S(U)$, with the restriction maps of
$\mathcal O_S$ (a ring map sends units to units). It is a sheaf of abelian groups on
$S_{\mathrm{proet}}$: let $\{U_i\to U\}$ be a covering and $u_i\in\mathbf G_{m,S}(U_i)$
agree on the overlaps $U_i\times_UU_j$; since $\mathcal O_S$ is a sheaf, the $u_i$ glue
to a unique $u\in\mathcal O_S(U)$ and the inverses $u_i^{-1}$, which also agree on the
overlaps, glue to a unique $v\in\mathcal O_S(U)$; then $uv$ restricts to $1$ on every
$U_i$, so $uv=1$ by the uniqueness of gluing, and $u$ is a unit. Uniqueness of the
glued unit is that in $\mathcal O_S$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: (CategoryTheory.sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology S) (CategoryTheory.forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat ⋙ CommMonCat.units ⋙ CommGrpCat.toAddCommGrp)).obj O_S, where O_S is the sheaf supplied by def-pur-proetale-structure-sheaf. sheafCompose is at Whiskering.lean:51-54; its object is the composite presheaf. CommMonCat.units, Algebra/Category/Grp/Adjunctions.lean:202-206, has obj R = CommGrpCat.of Rˣ and map f = Units.map f.hom, hence exactly the stated groups and restrictions. The right-adjoint instances for forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat (Algebra/Category/Ring/Adjunctions.lean:123-124) and CommMonCat.units (Algebra/Category/Grp/Adjunctions.lean:225-226, via CommGrpCat.forget₂CommMonAdj:209) provide the limit-preservation instances for the composite. Whiskering.lean:161-163 hasSheafCompose_of_preservesLimitsOfSize then supplies HasSheafCompose; equivalently CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf in CategoryTheory/Sites/Sheaf.lean:710 supplies the sheaf condition. CommGrpCat.toAddCommGrp (EquivalenceGroupAddGroup.lean:38-43) transports the multiplicative units object to the exact AddCommGrpCat coefficient category used by the target; the equivalence commGroupAddCommGroupEquivalence is at lines 78-85 and preserves the required limits. No nontriviality, finiteness, or invertibility hypothesis on S is required. Explicit instance chain read at CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Basic.lean:755-758 (Functor.isRightAdjoint_comp), CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Limits.lean:359-362 (right adjoints preserve limits of arbitrary size), and CategoryTheory/Limits/Preserves/Basic.lean:200-201 (Limits.comp_preservesLimits); thus the universe sizes in Whiskering.lean:161 are covered without further assumptions.
